connector.name: Superserve
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Superserve sandboxes: create, exec, and manage Firecracker microVMs
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.superserve.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the superserve-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — your Superserve API key, e.g. 'Bearer ss_live_...'.

env.name: SUPERSERVE_API_KEY
env.description: Superserve API key (starts with ss_live_). Create one at https://console.superserve.ai.

env.name: SUPERSERVE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Superserve control-plane API base URL. Defaults to https://api.superserve.ai.
